findings.description: The KMS key used to encrypt the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so the key material is never automatically rotated. Long-lived key material increases the blast radius if the key is ever compromised and weakens cryptographic hygiene for long-retention audit logs.

No explicit key policy is defined, so AWS applies the default policy delegating full key permissions to the account root, which allows any IAM principal with KMS permissions in the account to use or administer this audit-log encryption key. An audit trail key should have a least-privilege policy restricting decrypt/administration to specific principals.
